messages:
zoe: Quick sync - NimbusEdge wants to run a joint EAP: hardware preview + Azure Marketplace packaging + SI pre-integration with Accord Systems. They asked about NDA scope and announcement cadence.

partner-rep: Hi all - confirmed NDA inbound, expecting countersign this week. We want a lightweight benchmark set (latency + cost per token) and a short joint blog window after embargo lift. Also asking if Redwood can co-sponsor a SI pre-integration workshop with Accord.

raj: Sounds promising. Legal review note: if we include marketplace packaging we need to confirm export controls for the distributed image. @legal-bot can you verify restrictions?

legal-bot: NDA draft received 2026-03-20. Flag: NimbusEdge firmware contains a proprietary microcontroller image; export-control review required before publishing any distributable images on Azure Marketplace. Suggest adding an annex that disallows redistributing firmware blobs.

derek: For benchmarks, propose a 2-tier plan: 1) partner-facing internal perf using our EAP harness; 2) public-friendly aggregate numbers (tokens/sec, p95) for the joint blog. We'll redact sensitive fields.

zoe: Agree. Also need to coordinate the SI workshop timeline. Accord Systems asked for a 4-hour remote working session to test the reference deployment and run one end-to-end demo. Prefer during bench window week.

ops-bot: Tentative bench window reserved: LR-2026-NIM-08, 2026-04-05 -> 2026-04-09. Workshop slot held: 2026-04-07 13:00-17:00 PT (tentative).

partner-rep: We can ship 2 DevKits and 1 integration kit for Accord. ETA 2026-04-03. Will include marketplace packaging docs but not the firmware blobs.

raj: Good. Two questions: 1) Do we want Redwood to build the Marketplace VM image or guidance-only? 2) Who will present at the SI workshop?

derek: Suggest a guidance + templates approach: Redwood produces a sample ARM template and a minimal VM image skeleton (no firmware). That avoids redistributing partner firmware. For the workshop, nominate @zoe to lead Redwood's devops session and @derek to walk through performance tuning.

zoe: I can lead the devops part. Need sample ARM template and marketplace checklist. @partner-rep can you drop NimbusEdge marketplace docs into the shared drive?

partner-rep: Dropping docs now: link: https://drive.redwood/nimbusedge/marketplace-packaging. We'll redact firmware and include flash instructions for Accord to follow under MSA.

legal-bot: Action: add NDA annex forbidding firmware redistribution + require partner-provided verification that distributed images don't contain closed blobs. ETA for updated NDA: 2026-03-22 EOD.

ops-bot: Logistics: create ticket INF-EAP-989 with links to bench runbook and workshop agenda.

raj: Bench plan outline: 
- Day 1: Bring-up + basic thermal / nvme / network checks
- Day 2: Perf harness baseline (stock runtime)
- Day 3: SI workshop + integration smoke tests with Accord
- Day 4: Tuned runs + artifacts upload (s3://redwood-eap/nimbusedge/<kit-id>/)

zoe: Two action items for Redwood: 1) prep ARM template & marketplace checklist by 2026-03-30; 2) draft 30-min SI workshop agenda and circulate by 2026-03-28.

partner-rep: We'll confirm shipment and provide Accord contact. Also request a short NDA-friendly demo script for the joint blog video.

derek: I'll draft the demo script (30-45s perf highlights + 60s integration flow) and a sanitized metrics snapshot.

zoe: Great. If legal returns NDA with annex on Friday, I'll send invites and lock the workshop. :white_check_mark:
